items.title: Greenhouse gases aur un ke nuqsandeh asraat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the major greenhouse gases, their harmful effects and the Tidbits, printed pages 239-241.

items: Carbon Dioxide (CO₂): Yeh sab se ahem GHG hai. Yeh fossil fuels (koyla, tel aur gas) jalane aur jangalat ki katai (deforestation) se kharij hoti hai. Yeh GHG emissions ka taqreeban 80% hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. Qudrati greenhouse effect: suraj ki shuaain (solar radiation) greenhouse gases (CO2, H2O, CH4) ki patli teh aur atmosphere se guzar kar zameen tak; zameen se garmi wapas uthti hai, zyada garmi khala mein nikal jati aur kam garmi wapas lotti. Insani barhaya hua effect: zyada greenhouse gases (CO2, CH4, N2O) ki moti teh; kam garmi khala mein nikalti aur zyada garmi wapas zameen par lotti.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.9: Qudrati aur insani barhaya hua greenhouse effect (global warming ki aik wajah) (kitab ki Figure 25.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text:
World Meteorological Organization (WMO) ke mutabiq sanati daur se pehle (1900) hawa mein CO₂ ki miqdar taqreeban 280 parts per million (ppm) thi. 2026 mein yeh barh kar 428 ppm ho gayi hai aur abhi barh rahi hai.
Zameen ka asal ausat darja hararat 1900 se taqreeban 1°C barh chuka hai; is tabdeeli ko global warming kehte hain.

items: Methane (CH₄): Yeh koyle aur gas ki paidawar ke dauran, maweshiyon (gaaye bhainson ke maide mein khameer, yaani enteric fermentation) aur kheti ke tareeqon se banti hai. Yeh emissions ka taqreeban 11% hai.
Nitrous Oxide (N₂O): Yeh kheti aur sanati sargarmiyon aur fossil fuels jalane se kharij hoti hai. Yeh emissions ka taqreeban 6% hai.

Fluorinated Gases (aaj zyada tar HFCs; purani qism chlorofluorocarbons): Yeh insan ki banayi hui (synthetic) gases hain jo sanati amal se kharij hoti hain (jaise purane fridge aur air conditioner). Yeh emissions ka taqreeban 3% hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke yeh feesad har gas ka global warming mein hissa hain. Asal mein yeh greenhouse gases ke kul emissions (CO2 ke barabar) mein hisse hain, jo America ke adaad hain. Garmi barhane ke asar (radiative forcing) ke lehaaz se lambi umr wali gases ke hisse taqreeban yeh hain: CO2 66%, methane 16%, nitrous oxide 6-7% aur halocarbons 11%. Kitab fluorinated gases ko chlorofluorocarbons kehti hai, halanke aaj in mein zyada tar HFCs hain.
